levels.surface: عبد الله بن عامر بن زرارة

notes: «قال سألت أبا جعفر»: Thabit puts the question to Abu Ja'far, who answers «نعم»; the one asked is a link (rule 5)
«جابر بن عبد الله» is named only inside the question Thabit puts to Abu Ja'far, not as the transmitter of the answer; not added, the reading stops at Abu Ja'far
